finding_scope: Complete finite iterates of the binary Cantor word, all circular factor lengths from one symbol through one traversal; count length-tagged Parikh classes, not factor strings or occurrences.
integrity: The mathematical claim is supported by an elementary unrestricted proof plus a standalone finite replay; sources are not alleged to certify novelty.
scientific_limitations: No result for arbitrary prefixes, nonbinary substitutions or multiple traversals; finite checker to rank seven supplements but cannot establish the all-ranks theorem. Historical-priority review is not exhaustive and no independent mathematical audit was performed.
title: Exact circular Abelian spectra of finite Cantor words by binary carries
